(Presently Lodged At Sub Jail, Suratgarh).
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Saurabh Soni  Mr. Durgesh Khatri

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shrawan Kumar, PP  Mr. Hemant Vaishnav, for the  complainant  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/05/2023 The instant bail application has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C. in connection with FIR No.20/2023 registered at Police Station Rajiasar, District Sri Ganganagar, for the offence under Sections 376 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Rajiasar, District Sri Ganganagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the FIR No.20/2023 lodged at Police Station Rajiasar, District Sri Ganganagar.

entities.text: Police Station Rajiasar, District Sri Ganganagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that as a matter of fact, the prosecutrix herself has not supported the story narrated by her in the FIR which was lodged by her.

To substantiate the aforesaid contention, attention of the Court was drawn towards the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. on 08.02.2023 wherein, she has denied the allegations of being subjected to forcible sexual [2023/RJJD/015960] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-3202/2023] assault by the present petitioner.
On the aforesaid ground, learned counsel for the petitioner implored the Court to accept the application for bail.

Ramkumar vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/015960) on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55933666/
1

Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant opposed the bail application but were not in a position to refute the fact that the prosecutrix has not supported the contents of the FIR in her statements recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor so also learned counsel for the complainant.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties, keeping in view the statements of the prosecutrix and looking to the possibility that the trial may take a long time to conclude, this court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner-Ramkumar S/o Sh. Chanduram shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.20/2023 registered at Police Station Rajiasar, District Sri Ganganagar, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.
